pr_title: Allow ProblemDetails \ ValidationProblemDetails to be more testable

issue_context.title: Better Error Message in ControllerBase.ValidationProblem
issue_context.body:
### Describe the bug
During Unit Tests, I was getting a NullReferenceExeption in ControllerBase.ValidationProblem. Difficult to narrow down the problem.

### To Reproduce
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. 3.0.0
2. Create a controller unit test of an action that calls ValidationResult.

```
var c  = new MyController();
c.MyAction(); // Should call return new ValidationResult;
```

3. NullReferenceException was due to `ProblemDetailsFactory` being null, as `ProblemDetailsFactory => HttpContext?.RequestServices?.GetRequiredService<ProblemDetailsFactory>()` silently returns null.

### Expected behavior
Error message should be actual problem. NullReferenceException is not clear. Perhaps check for null when returning `ProblemDetailsFactory` property.

### Additional context
Add any other context about the problem here.
Include the output of `dotnet --info`
comments: Thanks for the issue report @bradlis7. We'd be happy to accept a PR to improve the error message here if you'd like to send one.

Hello I am facing the exact same issue as Nagarian, we want to use the RFC Response but our unittests Fail because of that Problem.

Thank you
There is an awkward way to test ValidationProblem: https://stackoverflow.com/questions/60740134/how-to-unit-test-whether-a-core-mvc-controller-action-calls-controllerbase-probl

review_comments: We have some precedence for having test-only code paths in Controller \ ControllerBase (e.g. https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/blob/f401f9869b5c15991e6d077c4afec555509b3482/src/Mvc/Mvc.Core/src/ControllerBase.cs#L75-L78). It felt excessive to author a default implementation of the factory when it's easy to instantiate `ProblemDetails` \ `ValidationProblemDetails` in the action.
